clips.title: The story
paras: Foreman Oslow is Lakeshire's beleaguered master builder, tasked with repairing the ruined Everstill Bridge in the heart of Redridge Mountains. Beset by Blackrock orc artillery and gnoll raiders, his reconstruction efforts have stalled due to lost shipments and sunken equipment. He relies heavily on traveling adventurers to retrieve his gear and secure materials so Lakeshire can reconnect its vital trade route.

Standing by the fractured masonry of the Everstill Bridge, Foreman Oslow faces an uphill battle. The bridge is the lifeline of Lakeshire, spanning the expanse of Lake Everstill and linking the western roads toward Elwynn to the eastern shores. Blackrock orcs, sweeping down from the crags of Stonewatch, targeted the crossing to cripple the town's logistics and military movement, leaving the settlement splintered and vulnerable.
